examples.note: Cotonou — 21 is the Littoral/Atlantique code, 30 the Cadjehoun district
Mobile — the 50–59 block is MTN Benin

notes: On 2024-11-30 Benin prefixed '01' to every number, taking the NSN from 8 to 10 digits. Older 8-digit Beninese numbers are no longer valid.
The leading 01 is part of the number, not a trunk prefix — it is dialled from abroad too.
sources: ARCEP Bénin — Autorité de Régulation des Communications Électroniques et de la Poste: https://arcep.bj/
